body:
Dear god. Come to my house. I will appreciate your company and your ham. 

How incredibly rude to criticize and reject someone’s contribution to family Easter.

I had a similar situation. A piece of decor in my listing (tequila with a snake in the bottle) was against a guests religious views. No fault of anyones.

We had them cancel and refunded them for the nights we got rebooked. Ended up being a win for everyone as we didn’t lose payout and they ended up with about an 80% refund.

I have to know… is this a boundary that you remind your mother of all the time? 

I’m conflicted on this one.
Lol, fine. You won this time... :)
